scripts.deploy:cf: echo 'Deploy to Cloudflare:' && echo '  pnpm deploy:cf:setup  - Create KV/R2/D1 resources' && echo '  pnpm deploy:cf:router  - Deploy edge router worker' && echo '  pnpm deploy:cf:search  - Build & deploy search app to Pages'
scripts.deploy:cf:search: pnpm --filter @anvil/search build && cd apps/search && npx wrangler pages deploy .next/static --project-name anvil-search
scripts.deploy:cf:drive: pnpm --filter @anvil/drive build && cd apps/drive && npx wrangler pages deploy .next/static --project-name anvil-drive
